title: Car Pooling
summary: Decide whether a car with limited seats can serve every trip, given where each group gets in and out.

tests.explain: Between stops 4 and 6 both groups are in the car: 3 + 2 = 5 passengers, more than 4 seats.
The peak is 5 passengers, which fits exactly.
The first group gets out at stop 4 before the second group gets in, so there are never more than 3 passengers.

hints: The car only drives east, so all that matters is how many passengers are inside at each stop.
A trip [p, from, to] adds p passengers at stop from and removes them at stop to. Record just those two changes in an array indexed by stop.
Walk the stops in order with a running sum of the changes (a difference array). If the running load ever exceeds capacity, return false.

complexity.time: O(n + S): one write pair per trip, then one pass over the S = 1001 stops
